messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning: The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water near San Jose Walmart. They want product info and stock status. We need to call the function walmart_purchase with location "San Jose" or "San Jose, CA" and product_list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"] and pack_size maybe [12] for bottled water? The function signature: loc: string, product_list: string[], pack_size?: number[]. The pack_size array should match product_list length. So we need pack_size array of same length: maybe [null, null, 12] or [0,0,12]? The default is not use it if not specified. But we can provide pack_size: [null, null, 12] or [0,0,12]. The function expects number[]; we can provide [0,0,12] or [null] but null is not number. So we should provide [0,0,12] or [1,1,12] but 1 for apples and rice? But pack_size is only applicable if product has pack size. For apples and rice, maybe pack size not needed. So we can provide [0,0,12] or [null] but null not number. So we can provide [0,0,12] or [1,1,12]. Let's use [0,0,12] meaning no pack size. The function will return product info and stock status. We'll call the function.
